info.title: Dynamic Form Builder API
info.description:
Build dynamic forms without code changes: drag-and-drop field ordering, 9 field types,
required/type validation, conditional visibility, public & authenticated submissions,
permission-based response editing with full history, search & filters, analytics,
Excel/PDF exports (Celery) and activity logs.

**Auth:** click **Authorize** and log in with your email as `username`.
Default admin: `admin@formbuilder.com` / `Admin@123` (change it!).

post.description: Self-registration. New accounts always get the **User** role.
OAuth2 password flow (form fields `username` = email, `password`). Works with Swagger's **Authorize** button.
JWTs are stateless: the client discards its tokens. This endpoint records the event.

post.description: Create a form, optionally with its fields in the same request.

put.description: Update form settings (title, description, visibility, edit permissions...).

delete.description: Delete a form together with all its fields and responses.

patch.description: Enable / disable a form. Disabled forms reject new submissions and submitter edits.

post.description: Copy a form's settings and fields (not responses). The copy starts disabled.

get.description: Activity on this form and its responses.

put.description:
**Drag-and-drop builder save.** Send the complete field list in display order.
Items with `id` are updated, items without `id` are created, missing fields are deleted.

post.description: Add one field. `order_index` sets its position (appended when omitted).

delete.description: Delete a field. Existing answers are kept in responses (label snapshot).

put.description: Reorder fields. `field_ids` must contain every field id of the form exactly once.

get.description: Form definition for the renderer (fields, options, validation config, visibility rules).

post.description:
Step 1 for file fields: upload the file, then send the returned `file_path`
as that field's answer in `/submit`.

Submit answers as `{field_key: value}`. Validation applies required rules,
type checks and conditional visibility (hidden fields are ignored).
On failure returns **422** with `errors: {field_key: message}`.

get.description: Responses of a form with **search, filters, sorting & pagination** (form owner / admin).

get.description: Responses submitted by the logged-in user (across all forms).

put.description:
Edit a response (send the **complete** answer set; it is re-validated).

Allowed for admins and the form owner, or for the original submitter when the
form has `allow_response_edit = true` and is active. Every change is stored in
the response history.

get.description: Full change history: the original submission followed by every edit (old -> new values).

schema.title: Response Response History Api V1 Responses  Response Id  History Get

get.description: Download a file uploaded in a response.

Dashboard KPIs, submission trend, top forms and recent responses.
Admins see platform-wide numbers (plus user counts); users see their own forms.

Form-wise analytics: totals, trend, and per-field stats (option distribution,
rating averages, number min/max/avg, response rate).

post.description:
**Async export via Celery.** Accepts the same filters as the responses list.
Poll `GET /exports/tasks/{task_id}` and download when status is `SUCCESS`.
